Specification: This module models a Single Producer, Multi Consumer Disruptor using a ring buffer. A producer publishes sequence numbers into the buffer, while multiple consumers read them, and the specification checks that all consumers read all published values in multicast style. The model uses bounded constants such as MaxPublished and Size, includes a state constraint to bound exploration, asserts type correctness and absence of data races through the instantiated ring buffer module, and states a liveness property requiring every consumer to eventually always have read each published value.
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE min \in Range(read) : \A r \in Readers : min <= read[r]
